name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-clawgrip
title: Redrawn Styled Clawgrip
description:
Custom graphics for Sonikku's SMB2 Clawgrip custom sprite, meant to be used alongside Icegoom's redrawn graphics.

Just like the main sprite, it uses SP3 and palette C by default, while his rock proyectile uses palette 9 instead (a custom one is included in any case).

Give credit if used, as it's always appreciated.
